name: HappyBirthday_1
short_caption: The robot mimics conducting an orchestra and playing a flute to celebrate a birthday.
movement_description: The robot starts by raising both arms to chest height, gently swaying them side-to-side in a conducting motion. It then brings its right hand up near its mouth while holding its left arm out to the side, mimicking playing a transverse flute. After another brief conducting motion, it repeats the flute-playing gesture before slowly lowering both arms back to its sides to return to the neutral posture.
safety_notes: The robot's arms sweep in front of its chest and up towards its face; ensure there is clearance directly in front of the tablet area.
